message:
System Update — Autumn v2 · May 2026
Several new features are now live. A weather tool has been added, allowing Autumn to pull real-time conditions directly into conversation. A formal GitHub login system is also active — logging in with your GitHub account enables personal memory storage that persists across sessions in a private repository only you can access.
A developer branch is now in place so future updates can be tested before going live. On occasion you may notice direct live updates during active sessions — we appreciate your patience as we continue to refine the experience.
Coming soon: a more robust standalone NLP engine for Autumn. In the meantime, adding an Anthropic API key in your settings is recommended to significantly enhance Autumn's language processing and response quality.
— Radical Deepscale LLC
author: dartsolarpunk
